Worth one correction to the plan's wording: packages/guard/tsconfig.json
already sets both, so the accurate statement is that no other package NEEDS
them — @fde/guard's source contains no decorator, and its two flags are
inherited boilerplate rather than a requirement.
`tsBuildInfoFile` IS INSIDE `dist/` DELIBERATELY. Left at the package root it
is not one of turbo's declared outputs, so it SURVIVES a cache restore that
wiped dist/ — and then tsc reads it, concludes everything is up to date, and
emits nothing. The observable result is `pnpm build` reporting success with no
dist/main.js in it. Incremental state belongs with the artefact it describes.
`generated/` IS EXCLUDED FROM `include` ON PURPOSE. The Prisma clients are
emitted as compiled JS plus .d.ts, so tsc must not try to recompile them —
it resolves their types through the import and leaves the runtime files
where they are. `src` and `dist` are both one level under the package root,
